question: The ‘Nijaat’ (riddance) anti-drug campaign launched by a district police of which state has been acknowledged and appreciated by many Bollywood actors in 2021?
solution:
The correct option is__** Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nijaat** campaign is launched by the district police of** Koriya** in the state of **Chhattisgarh**.
 
• **World Drug day** is celebrated on 26 June.
 
• **National Anti-Drug day i**s celebrated on 2nd October.
 
• **"Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan"** is launched by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.**
 
• "Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyan was launched in 272 most vulnerable districts science August 2020 to address the problem of Drug Abuse among the youth of India.
